title: Environmental telemetry logger
subtitle: Persistent records and acknowledged delivery across outages
problem: A hobby greenhouse operator wants temperature and humidity history even when the nearby gateway is unavailable. This prototype samples an SHT31, keeps a bounded persistent queue, sends records over a local 3.3 V UART link, and sleeps between cycles. UART is a bench link; remote deployment would need a suitable physical layer.
summary: Each wake reads the sensor once, checks its CRC and saves a record. The oldest saved record is sent first. The computer gateway commits it to SQLite before acknowledging its sequence number. If that acknowledgment is lost, the device repeats the record; the database recognizes the sequence and avoids a second row. The ESP32 then sleeps for 60 seconds.

wiring: SHT31 GND and USB TTL GND
decisions: The SHT31 driver issues command 0x2400, waits 20 ms and requests six bytes. Both two-byte fields must match CRC-8 polynomial 0x31 initialized to 0xff. Invalid or incomplete readings do not enter the queue. Integer centi-units avoid floating-point formatting ambiguity.

A 284-byte versioned store includes the queue, sequence allocator and drop counter plus CRC-32. It is saved as one NVS blob before any record is sent. A corrupt existing blob faults closed; it is not silently replaced with sequence 1. The format is little-endian and tied to this ABI; the static assertion catches layout changes.

ACK must match the oldest sequence. Each record gets at most three attempts of 250 ms; at most four records are tried per wake. Parser buffers and per-iteration input byte counts are bounded, so an endless noisy stream cannot indefinitely extend a deadline.

The gateway validates payload CRC, ranges and format, then commits SQLite with synchronous FULL. A duplicate with the same payload is acknowledged; a conflicting reuse of the same device/sequence ID is refused. The transaction is durable before ACK. This provides at-least-once transmission and deduplicated storage, not exactly-once transport.

One Arduino task owns the bus, queue and NVS. The task watchdog bounds unexpected hangs. Radio functions are not started. Deep sleep is configured after serial flush; development-board regulator, LEDs and USB circuitry mean low chip sleep current does not imply low board current.

failures: The initial store-size assertion expected 288 bytes; compilation established the actual layout is 284 bytes and the assertion was corrected before recording final results. Review also tightened gateway sequence-conflict checks inside the transaction so competing writers cannot cause a conflicting payload to be acknowledged.
limitations: A 32-record queue cannot survive an unbounded outage. At one reading per wake, it covers roughly 32 wake cycles, not exactly 32 minutes because the sleep interval follows active work. Flash writes every wake and ACK create wear; endurance has not been measured. Persistent format migration, secure authentication, real-time timestamps and a long-distance link are not implemented. CRC protects against accidental corruption, not an attacker. A stuck I2C line is retried on a later wake; no automatic bus-clock recovery is claimed.

questions: Why persist before sending?
If power fails after sending but before local persistence, the gateway might have a record whose ID the device later reuses. Persisting first preserves allocation and replay state.
Why can duplicates occur?
The gateway may commit a record and its ACK may be lost. The sender cannot distinguish that from data loss, so it retries.
Is this exactly-once delivery?
No. Transmission is at least once within the configured retry/storage bounds. The gateway uses a primary key to store one row per device and sequence.
Why is CRC needed on I2C?
An ACK confirms a byte transfer, not the integrity of the sensor measurement. SHT31 supplies CRC bytes for its data words.
What if the queue is full?
The newest sample is rejected and the loss counter increments. Older unacknowledged records retain their identity and order.
How is battery life estimated?

Measure average current across complete cycles first. Usable battery capacity divided by average current is an idealized estimate; derating, regulator efficiency and self-discharge must be explicit. No life figure is claimed here.
What if sequence numbers wrap?
Zero is reserved. After UINT32_MAX is allocated, new records are refused instead of reusing gateway identities. An explicit reprovisioning scheme would be a future improvement.
What happens after a corrupt store?
The firmware emits a fault and does not send. Silent reset to an empty queue could reuse IDs and hide lost records.
Why not Wi-Fi or MQTT?
A local UART gateway makes reliability and persistence testable without infrastructure. It isolates the protocol learning objective; a later radio adapter can preserve the same queue semantics.
What is the main deployment limitation?
The board power budget, flash wear, timestamps and physical link all need improvement or measurement. Host success establishes logic, not battery operation or environmental durability.
